title: SetError struct: public fields with no #[non_exhaustive] — adding a field is a breaking change
description: backend.rs:52-67: SetError has 4 public fields (error_type, description, properties, existing_id) but no #[non_exhaustive]. A builder pattern (SetError::new().with_description()) is provided and documented, but the struct can also be constructed or pattern-matched with struct literal syntax by external users. Adding a new field (e.g., 'details', 'status_code') is a semver-breaking change without #[non_exhaustive]. Add #[non_exhaustive] to enforce builder-only construction going forward.
